title: Symbol Modulator
text: 将数据比特调制为复数据符号，输入 5 路、输出 2 路；按 {Modulation} 指定调制类型；{Modulation source} 指定调制类型来源、{Modulation array} 指定调制数组、{Constellation ordering type} 指定星座排序类型、{Constellation mapping} 指定星座映射、{Constellation mapping array} 指定星座映射数组、{Phase offset (rad)} 指定相位偏移、{Phase offset type} 指定相位偏移类型、{Phase offset array (rad)} 指定相位偏移数组、{Normalization method} 指定缩放信号星座 Minimum distance between、{Minimum distance} 指定符号间最小距离、{Average power, referenced to 1 ohm (watts)} 指定星座中符号的平均功率、{Enable reset input port} 指定重置输入端口、{Output data type} 输出数据类型选择、{Word length} 输出字长，按实例取值。

params.name: Modulation source
params.values: 调制类型来源 Property (default) | Input port

params.name: Modulation array
params.values: 调制数组 {"BPSK", "QPSK"} (default) | all the supported modulation types

params.name: Constellation ordering type
params.values: 星座排序类型 Default (default) | User-defined

params.name: Constellation mapping array
params.values: 星座映射数组 {[0 1],[0 1 3 2]} (default) | row vector in a cell array

params.name: Phase offset (rad)
params.values: 相位偏移 0 (default) | pi | pi/2 | pi/4 | pi/8 | pi/16 | pi/32 | -pi/32 | -pi/16 | -pi/8 | -pi/4 | -pi/2

params.name: Phase offset type
params.values: 相位偏移类型 Default (default) | User-defined

params.name: Phase offset array (rad)
params.values: 相位偏移数组 [0 pi/4] (default) | scalar | row vector of supported phase offset values

params.name: Normalization method
params.values: 缩放信号星座 Minimum distance between symbols (default) | Average power

params.name: Minimum distance
params.values: 符号间最小距离 0.125 (default) | positive scalar in the range from 1/32 to 1/8

params.name: Average power, referenced to 1 ohm (watts)
params.values: 星座中符号的平均功率 1 (default) | positive scalar in the range 1/32 to 10

params.name: Enable reset input port
params.values: 重置输入端口 off (default) | on

params.name: Output data type
params.values: 输出数据类型选择 Custom (default) | double | single

params.name: Word length
params.values: 输出字长 16 (default) | integer in the range from 3 to 32
